instruction: DIRECTIVE DIR-0014 · kind EXECUTE+VERIFY+REPORT · priority high · no real-money risk (testnet only). CONTEXT: user directive 'integrate top 200 most liquid assets from binance in our terminal across crypto, indices, metals, forex etc. — we will trade at demo binance account first'. Shipped in the sandbox as Tier-2 of the terminal (commit follows this directive): Binance-NATIVE top-200 universe (every TRADING USDT-M perp ranked by rolling 24h quote volume; re-ranked every 4h; exchangeInfo tick/step precision), 6 new routes /api/binance/{universe,quotes,klines,market,account,order}, browser WebSocket feeds (!miniTicker@arr 1s grid · @depth20@100ms L2 · @trade tape · @forceOrder liquidations), UI (BINANCE 200 grid button, BinanceView symbol page, palette group + rank badges — 287 instruments total), and the TESTNET demo order ticket (DemoAccountPanel) gated server-side by BINANCE_MODE=testnet. No new npm dependencies (package-lock.json unchanged). TASKS: 1. git pull --rebase. 2. npm ci ONLY if package-lock.json changed (it should NOT change). 3. npm run build, restart :3000. 4. ADD DEMO KEYS LOCALLY: the user provided futures-TESTNET API keys on 2026-11-11 (chat). Ask the user to paste them into the local .env as BINANCE_API_KEY / BINANCE_API_SECRET / BINANCE_MODE=testnet (NEVER commit — .env is gitignored). Without keys the market data works fully; only the demo order panel shows 'not configured'. Keys were verified on the sandbox against https://testnet.binancefuture.com/fapi/v2/account → 200, canTrade=true, ~4096 USDT fake balance. 5. VERIFY endpoints (curl 127.0.0.1:3000): (a) /api/binance/universe expect ok:true n:200 assets ranked (BTC #1); (b) /api/binance/market?sym=ZEC expect ok:true with ticker.last ~950-1000, mark.fundingRatePct, oi.usd ~$400-500M; (c) /api/binance/klines?sym=ZEC&interval=15m&limit=120 expect 120 rows; (d) /api/binance/account expect ok:true mode:testnet (with local keys) or ok:false honest 'not configured' (without); (e) /api/cg/live?sym=ZEC expect ok:true source binance-fapi; (f) regression: /api/cg/assets 15, /api/cg/classic?list=1 84, /api/health 200. 6. VERIFY browser (Chrome DevTools MCP): (a) header shows '15 perp + 188 binance + 84 classic = 287 instruments'; (b) BINANCE 200 button → grid with LIVE · WS 1s badge and ~200 rows; (c) click ZEC row (or ?sym=ZEC) → BinanceView: ORDER BOOK 'L2 depth20 @100ms · live' with 20-level ladder + spread + imbalance, TRADE TAPE with N/s counter, chart 300 bars with 'forming O … H …' live candle, funding/next-funding/OI stats populated, BINANCE DEMO ACCOUNT 'TESTNET · LIVE' with wallet + order ticket (if keys configured: place a far-from-market LIMIT, verify orderId accepted, then cancel all — fake funds only); (d) ALL ⌄ palette shows 'Binance perps (top-200 liquidity) · 188' group with #rank badges; (e) zero console errors on all views. 7. Note for your egress: if YOUR host IP ever gets an fapi 429/418 weight ban, the Binance stats/klines fall back to browser-direct fapi automatically (badge: 'browser-direct (host fapi-banned)') and the shared breaker recovers within ~60s — do not restart for that. REPLY per contract (VERDICT/CHECKS/REASONING/ACTION/EVIDENCE) in desk/outbox/<this basename>.reply.md.
